title: Effects Of Cooking
paragraphs: “It had quite a unique flavor, but it was delicious.”
“I’m glad you liked it.”
After enjoying the dinner Father prepared, we all sat around the fire, chatting leisurely. I ate some as well, and just as I expected, it was delicious.
“Yeah, all of these dishes look similar to the ones I know, but they’re still different. It was the same back in Melromarc too… as expected of another world.”
“How did you come up with tonight’s meal?”
“I asked people at the market how it’s usually cooked, and then I just went with my instincts. So it might not be exactly like the real thing.”
“You came up with this just by instinct…?”
Ren and Itsuki stared at their empty plates in amazement. They should be even more surprised. At the sheer talent overflowing from Father.
“To get a more accurate taste, I guess we’d need to try the real thing first…”
“It feels like we’ve finally gained some breathing room.”
“Yeah.”
“It’s good to see the heroes doing well.”
Éclair nodded in agreement as she maintained her weapons. Following her lead, Ren and Itsuki headed down to the river to wash their clothes.
“Guaa!”

Yuki and the other Filolials were still munching on the special food Father had made for them. They worked hard today, after all. Father was also taking care of the cooking utensils. Should I do something too?
“Motoyasu-san, you…”
“You don’t need to do anything. You’ve been working the hardest out of all of us.”
“It feels wrong for me to be the only one relaxing. I suppose I’ll prepare the bath again tonight?”
“That’d be great. Thanks.”
Just like yesterday, I started preparing the bath. Well, all I really did was heat the water using magic.
“We’ve basically gone full survival mode, but do you think we’ll be able to leave tomorrow?”
“The Filolials are supposed to transform tonight, right?”
“Apparently. I don’t see any signs of it happening yet, though.”
“That’s because their level is accelerating their growth. Normally, it would take another full day.”

So in reality, it was hard to say exactly when it would happen. But once they took on their angelic forms, they would be both divine and adorable—truly a sight to behold. I was already getting excited just thinking about it.
“We don’t really have time to just play around, do we?”
“Even if we wanted to take on quests at a guild, that’d be difficult considering we’re basically criminals right now.”
“Yeah, and how do we even get identification papers? In a game, it’d just happen automatically depending on the system, but here…”
“Quests, huh… If we try to approach them with game logic, we might get burned. That said, we don’t really have to worry about money—Motoyasu already secured more than enough.”
“There are things that require pouring money into for strengthening, so eventually, we’ll run out.”
“Was it about how to enhance Projectile Weapons?”

I end up spending a significant amount of money on that, I say. So while we won’t have any trouble with funds for a while, in the end, even Father from the first world warned me to only enhance the weapons I use the most. After all, there were a lot of heroes. If all of them spent money like water, the funds would dry up in no time.
“An unknown enhancement method we don’t know about, huh? Looks like there’s still more to discover.”
“Even though we’re still in the process of learning the Four Holy Weapons’ enhancement methods, now there are others too? If we try to cram in too much at once, it might get overwhelming.”
“Yeah. The biggest issue is that these methods won’t even reveal themselves unless you believe in them, and on top of that, they’re complicated.”
“But if it’s similar to a game, maybe we can get the hang of it through intuition? Are there more?”
“Of course. There are also many techniques that require practice to master. For example, the magic that only heroes can use—Liberation Magic—requires effort to learn.”
Father’s smile stiffened slightly.
“Wow… Looks like we really do need to put in some serious effort if we want to survive in the future.”
“Ren and Itsuki, you might understand another technique—Energy Boost. If you think of it as a class trait, it should be easier to grasp.”
“What’s that?”
“Oh, if it’s easy to learn, then teach us.”
“It’s basically ‘Ki’—a technique that, in RPG terms, is typically used by monks or martial artists.”
“Ah… It’s not part of the Legendary Weapons’ system, but we can still use it?”
“If you think about it, since it’s a technique rather than a weapon ability, it should be possible for other classes to learn it through training. Though, I imagine it’s pretty difficult.”
Their ability to absorb information has improved quite a bit. Last time, Ren and Itsuki refused to believe anything I told them. And yet, here we are. As their teacher, I feel quite pleased.
“In games, eating food can temporarily boost stats or grant special effects, but how does that work in this world?”
“I’ve never tested it.”

Even in Emerald Online, there were food items that provided temporary stat boosts. For example, they could slightly increase certain abilities for a set period. If you think about it, isn’t that kind of important?
“I doubt it works that way here. With all the enhancement methods we’ve already got, adding buffs from food wouldn’t make much of a difference for heroes.”
“You can’t say that for sure. If food effects scale based on percentages, they could be pretty significant.”
“And it’s Naofumi’s cooking we’re talking about…”
“I don’t think he’s that good at cooking, though.”

However, if I really think about it, big sister and Filo-tan both grew up eating Father’s cooking. So there’s a possibility that’s why their growth was so exceptional. I remember the day I first went hunting with Big Sister. She was so dedicated to her training in her room. Back then, when I was all depressed, I used to be put off by physically strong women…
Well, considering I was the kind of guy who used to chase after pigs, I guess I wasn’t really picky about types back then.
